Name: ACME, LLC
Description: Smallest viable rulebook with a calculated field — the "Hello, formulas" tutorial.

Customers.summary_rich: The **client ledger** of ACME, LLC. Every customer has raw contact facts plus calculated identifiers such as `Name` and `FullName`. Edit the email or name parts and those derived labels re-compute in every generated substrate.

schema.name: Name
schema.explanation_rich: **A handle derived from the email, not the name.** `Name = SUBSTITUTE(EmailAddress, "@", "-")` — a single character swap turns an address into a slug. Worked example: `bob@gmail.com` becomes `bob-gmail.com`, which is what shows up as `Name` in every substrate. Change the customer's email and the handle re-derives itself in Postgres, Python, Excel, and OWL the next read — no application code, no migration.

schema.name: FirstName
schema.Description: First Name of the customer - used to make the full name

schema.name: LastName
schema.Description: Last Name of the customer - used to make the full name

schema.name: FullName
schema.Description: Full name is computed from the first and last name of the customer
schema.explanation_rich: **First name first.** `FullName = FirstName & " " & LastName`. Worked example: `FirstName="Bobby"` and `LastName="Smith"` resolves to `"Bobby Smith"`. Change this one formula and every generated substrate reads the new format on its next build.
